sentences.en: Encouraging her to come forward.
sentences.zh: 这个叙述开始变得比她个人大得多。

sentences.en: This account was starting to become much bigger than her alone.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，当这一切在幕后上演时，

sentences.en: And meanwhile, while all of this is playing out behind the scenes,
sentences.zh: 卡瓦诺的提名正在公开推进。

sentences.en: Kavanaugh's nomination is moving forward in public.
sentences.zh: 但对于与白宫人士交谈的总统来说，他们似乎很有信心，他们的选择，卡瓦诺法官，将会顺利通过。

sentences.en: But for the president talking to the folks of the White House, they seem to be confident that their pick, Judge Kavanaugh, will sail through.
sentences.zh: 布雷特·卡瓦诺法官简直是美国最高法院最合格、最值得的提名人。

sentences.en: That Judge Brett Kavanaugh is quite simply the most qualified and the most deserving nominee to the Supreme Court of the United States.
sentences.zh: 很多焦点都在他对比女性和女孩的支持上。

sentences.en: A lot of the focus is on his support for women and girls.
sentences.zh: 我一直试图像我父亲和我建立联系那样，与我的女儿们建立联系。

sentences.en: I have tried to create bonds with my daughters like my dad created with me.
sentences.zh: 他曾执教过他女儿的女子篮球队的事实。

sentences.en: The fact that he has coached his daughter's girls' basketball team.
sentences.zh: 在过去的七年里，我一直执教我女儿的篮球队。

sentences.en: For the past seven years, I have coached my daughter's basketball teaMs.
sentences.zh: 以及他雇佣了很多女性书记员的事实。

sentences.en: And the fact that he has hired a lot of female clerks.
sentences.zh: 就像他母亲在教学方面的记录，然后供自己读法学院，他与女儿们的关系，所有这些。

sentences.en: Like everything from his mother's record in teaching and then putting herself through law school, his relationship with his girls.
sentences.zh: 我可能只是在盲目追随。

sentences.en: I might be just drinking Kool-Aid.
sentences.zh: 我可能只是在盲目追随。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But I sat there.
sentences.zh: 但我坐在那里。

sentences.en: I was like, this guy seems so amazing.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，这家伙看起来太棒了。

sentences.en: So Ford is agonizing over what to do now that Kavanaugh has been nominated.
sentences.zh: 所以，在卡瓦诺被提名后，福特一直在为该怎么做而苦恼。

sentences.en: And she's hearing all of these glowing accounts of his record with women.
sentences.zh: 她听到了所有关于他对待女性记录的溢美之词。

sentences.en: And she wants her account to be considered too.
sentences.zh: 她也希望自己的陈述能被考虑在内。

sentences.en: And so at the end of July, Congresswoman Eschew's office instructs her to write a letter to the committee,
sentences.zh: 因此在七月底，埃舒议员的办公室指示她写一封信给委员会，

sentences.en: to the ranking members of the committee that's going to be voting on Kavanaugh's nomination.
sentences.zh: 写给即将对卡瓦诺提名进行投票的委员会的资深成员。

sentences.en: But Ford chooses to only send that letter to the ranking Democrat, Senator Dianne Feinstein of California.
sentences.zh: 但福特选择只把那封信寄给民主党资深成员，加州的黛安·范斯坦参议员。

sentences.en: It's her understanding that as a constituent of Feinstein's, she's going to be guaranteed confidentiality.
sentences.zh: 她认为，作为范斯坦的选民，她的保密性会得到保证。

sentences.en: And she has told us that in that moment of submitting the letter to Feinstein's office, that it dawned on her for the first time, oh, my God, I need a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我们，在向范斯坦办公室提交信件的那一刻，她第一次意识到，天哪，我需要一位律师。

sentences.en: And she ends up working with Debbie Katz and Lisa Banks, two of the more prominent feminist attorneys in the country who are based in Washington,
sentences.zh: 最终，她与黛比·卡茨和丽莎·班克斯合作，这两位是华盛顿当地更著名的女权主义律师，

sentences.en: in this story that's starting to unfold.
sentences.zh: 在这个故事开始展开的时候。

sentences.en: So that's when I get a call from one of those lawyers, Debbie Katz.
sentences.zh: 所以，我接到了其中一位律师黛比·卡茨的电话。

sentences.en: It's Saturday, August 11th.
sentences.zh: 那是8月11日，星期六。

sentences.en: She's just met Ford a couple of days before.
sentences.zh: 她几天前才刚见过福特。

sentences.en: She's already sounding very, very worried.
sentences.zh: 她听起来已经非常、非常担心了。

sentences.en: She doesn't tell us Ford's name.
sentences.zh: 她没有告诉我们福特的名字。

sentences.en: But what she says is that this client is completely credible, that she's a scientist, that she's very precise, that she tells her story very consistently,
sentences.zh: 但她说的是，这位当事人完全可信，她是一位科学家，非常严谨，讲述故事时非常连贯，

sentences.en: that Katz really, really believes her.
sentences.zh: 卡茨真的、真的相信她。

sentences.en: But what she also said is that she doesn't quite know what she's gotten herself into.
sentences.zh: 但她也说，她不太清楚自己卷入了什么事情。

sentences.en: She says, my new client is naive about how big this could become.
sentences.zh: 她说，我的新当事人对于这件事可能会变得多大还很天真。

sentences.en: Katz doesn't really have a point of view at this point about whether she should come forward or not.
sentences.zh: 卡茨目前对于她是否应该站出来还没有明确的观点。

sentences.en: But she wants me to quietly pass along the story to the paper to ask the editors to further investigate Kavanaugh's treatment of women
sentences.zh: 但她希望我能悄悄地把这个故事传给报社，要求编辑们进一步调查卡瓦诺对待女性的方式，

sentences.en: because she wants to know if there's a pattern here or if her client is alone.
sentences.zh: 因为她想知道这是否是一种模式，还是说她的当事人是孤立的个案。

sentences.en: And by the way, she had asked Feinstein's office the same thing.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，她也问过范斯坦办公室同样的问题。

sentences.en: This was what she was trying to find out.
sentences.zh: 这就是她试图查明的事情。

sentences.en: And the paper does start to look more closely at Kavanaugh's record with women.
sentences.zh: 报社确实开始更仔细地审视卡瓦诺对待女性的记录。

sentences.en: But Ford's story itself, her allegations, aren't published in the Times.
sentences.zh: 但福特的故事本身，她的指控，并没有在《时报》上发表。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we now know that that's because at this moment in time, she has decided to go the congressional route.
sentences.zh: 我们现在知道，那是因为在当时，她已经决定走国会路线了。

sentences.en: And in deciding to go the congressional route, she's now facing a new deadline.
sentences.zh: 而决定走国会路线，意味着她现在面临一个新的截止日期。

sentences.en: President Trump's pick to be the next Supreme Court justice will get his Senate confirmation hearing next month.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统挑选的下一任最高法院大法官人选，下个月将接受参议院的确认听证会。

sentences.en: The Senate Judiciary hearings on Kavanaugh's nomination are set to begin right after Labor Day.
sentences.zh: 参议院司法委员会关于卡瓦诺提名的听证会定于劳动节后立即开始。

sentences.en: Hearings for Brett Kavanaugh will begin on September 4th.
sentences.zh: 布雷特·卡瓦诺的听证会将于9月4日开始。

sentences.en: It's a process the Trump administration has said it wants wrapped up before November's midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府表示，希望在11月中期选举前结束这一进程。

sentences.en: So she has to make a decision before then.
sentences.zh: 所以她必须在那之前做出决定。

sentences.en: But remember, it's a confusing situation because she doesn't even know these new lawyers.
sentences.zh: 但请记住，这是一个令人困惑的情况，因为她甚至不认识这些新律师。

sentences.en: She's in California.
sentences.zh: 她在加州。

sentences.en: They're in D.C.
sentences.zh: 她们在华盛顿特区。

sentences.en: They're having these intense phone calls.
sentences.zh: 她们在进行这些紧张的电话交谈。

sentences.en: These lawyers, Debbie Katz and Lisa Banks, are trying not to impose a point of view on her.
sentences.zh: 这些律师，黛比·卡茨和丽莎·班克斯，正试图不把自己的观点强加给她。

sentences.en: They really feel that the decision has to be hers.
sentences.zh: 她们真心觉得这个决定必须由她自己来做。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, she's sitting there in California saying, what do these lawyers want me to do?
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，她坐在加州说，这些律师想让我做什么？

sentences.en: Do they have a point of view on this?
sentences.zh: 她们对此有观点吗？

sentences.en: And into this mix comes Rikki Seidman.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，里基·塞德曼加入了进来。

sentences.en: And Rikki Seidman was a veteran of Supreme Court confirmation battles and a longtime Democratic operative.
sentences.zh: 里基·塞德曼是最高法院确认战的老手，也是长期的民主党操盘手。

sentences.en: She had a lot of experience in Supreme Court confirmation battles.
sentences.zh: 她在最高法院确认战中经验丰富。

sentences.en: In fact, she had been working on the committee that had first learned of Anita Hill's allegations against Clarence Thomas.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她曾在那届委员会工作，该委员会首次获悉了安妮塔·希尔对克拉伦斯·托马斯的指控。

sentences.en: And she had encouraged Hill to speak further to the committee, a great personal toll to Hill.
sentences.zh: 她曾鼓励希尔向委员会进一步说明，这对希尔造成了巨大的个人伤害。

sentences.en: And so she enters the picture and she brings with her all this concern that that exact same thing could happen to Ford if she came forward.
sentences.zh: 所以她进入了画面，并带来了所有的担忧，即如果福特站出来，同样的事情可能会发生在福特身上。

sentences.en: And so Katz and Banks, the lawyers, are trying their best to be neutral and weigh out the potential pros and cons.
sentences.zh: 因此，律师卡茨和班克斯正尽最大努力保持中立，权衡潜在的利弊。

sentences.en: But Seidman is pretty adamant.
sentences.zh: 但塞德曼非常坚定。

sentences.en: In fact, at one point, she flies to California and meets with Ford in person and spells out all the reasons she thinks she should not come forward.
sentences.zh: 事实上，有一次，她飞往加州亲自会见福特，并列举了她认为她不应该站出来的所有理由。

sentences.en: So Ford at that point has not made a decision and her team feels that she really needs to because the nomination is moving forward in Washington.
sentences.zh: 所以福特在那时还没有做出决定，她的团队觉得她真的需要做出决定，因为提名在华盛顿正在推进。

sentences.en: It's very heated.
sentences.zh: 气氛非常激烈。

sentences.en: It's very partisan.
sentences.zh: 非常党派化。

sentences.en: But it looks like things are ultimately going to go pretty smoothly for Kavanaugh.
sentences.zh: 但看起来卡瓦诺的事情最终会进行得相当顺利。

sentences.en: And so what they decide to do in order to facilitate a decision on Ford's part is they set an artificial deadline.
sentences.zh: 所以为了促进福特做出决定，她们决定设定一个人为的截止日期。

sentences.en: They say by August 29th, which is a few days before the hearings are going to begin, we're going to choose one of three letters that we're writing.
sentences.zh: 她们说，到8月29日，也就是听证会开始前几天，我们将从我们起草的三封信中选择一封。

sentences.en: And they actually draft these three letters.
sentences.zh: 她们确实起草了这三封信。

sentences.en: And it's like each letter could lead to a different outcome, not only for Ford, but for the country.
sentences.zh: 就像每一封信都可能导致不同的结果，不仅对福特，对国家也是如此。

sentences.en: They're all variations on the choices she could make.
sentences.zh: 它们都是她可能做出的选择的变体。

sentences.en: So Ford and her team are looking at these letters and Ford still can't make a decision and their deadline passes.
sentences.zh: 所以福特和她的团队看着这些信，福特仍然无法做出决定，截止日期过去了。

sentences.en: And then it's Thursday, which is the day after the deadline.
sentences.zh: 然后是周四，也就是截止日期的第二天。

sentences.en: And at this point, the hearings are really about to begin and she is just unable to choose.
sentences.zh: 此时，听证会真的要开始了，而她就是无法做出选择。

sentences.en: Kat says to her, this is a life-defining decision and it's yours.
sentences.zh: 卡茨对她说，这是一个决定人生的决定，它是属于你的。

sentences.en: But Ford can't make a decision and that, in effect, becomes the decision.
sentences.zh: 但福特无法做出决定，而这实际上就成了决定。

sentences.en: That night, she sends one of her sons to sleep with her husband and she climbs into his IKEA bed and she says to herself, look, on some level, I deserved the chance to try this.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，她让她的一个儿子去和她丈夫睡，她爬进他宜家的床上，对自己说，看，在某种程度上，我理应有机会尝试一下。

sentences.en: And sitting there in her child's bed, she sobs.
sentences.zh: 坐在孩子床上，她啜泣着。

sentences.en: And so on September 4th, the Kavanaugh hearings begin.
sentences.zh: 于是9月4日，卡瓦诺听证会开始了。

sentences.en: And sure, there's some controversy, but for the most part, it's looking like smooth sailing that Kavanaugh will, in fact, be easily confirmed.
sentences.zh: 当然，有一些争议，但大部分情况下，看起来一切顺利，卡瓦诺实际上会很容易地获得确认。

sentences.en: But the following week, on Monday, Ford, back in California, shows up for her first day of teaching.
sentences.zh: 但接下来的一周，周一，回到加州的福特，出现在她第一天的教学中。

sentences.en: And it's clear that word of her allegation is continuing to seep out.
sentences.zh: 很明显，关于她指控的消息正在继续泄露。

sentences.en: At the end of class, she's approached by a reporter from BuzzFeed who says, I know about the letter.
sentences.zh: 下课时，一名来自BuzzFeed的记者走近她说，我知道那封信的事。

sentences.en: She orders the reporter to leave the classroom, to leave the building.
sentences.zh: 她命令记者离开教室，离开大楼。

sentences.en: But there are reporters who are showing up at her home.
sentences.zh: 但有记者出现在她家门口。

sentences.en: They are calling her colleagues.
sentences.zh: 他们在给她的同事打电话。

sentences.en: And on September 12th...
sentences.zh: 而在9月12日……

sentences.en: Tonight, the mysterious new twist about Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh...
sentences.zh: 今晚，关于最高法院提名人布雷特·卡瓦诺的神秘新转折……

sentences.en: There is a bombshell report involving Brett Kavanaugh.
sentences.zh: 有一份涉及布雷特·卡瓦诺的重磅报道。

sentences.en: The Intercept, an online publication, actually publishes an article.
sentences.zh: 在线出版物《拦截》实际上发表了一篇文章。

sentences.en: It is quite a doozy.
sentences.zh: 这真是个重磅炸弹。

sentences.en: We don't know too many details about these allegations.
sentences.zh: 我们对这些指控了解的细节不多。

sentences.en: About the fact that the Democrats are aware that Feinstein has received a letter about Kavanaugh and something that happened with a woman in high school,
sentences.zh: 关于民主党人知道范斯坦收到了一封关于卡瓦诺的信，以及高中时期发生的一名女性相关的事情，

sentences.en: and that they're trying to obtain it.
sentences.zh: 而且他们正试图获取它。

sentences.en: So let me give you her exact quote on this.
sentences.zh: 让我给你引用一下她关于此事的原话。

sentences.en: She says, I have received information from an individual concerning the nomination of Brett Kavanaugh to the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 她说，我从一个人那里收到了关于布雷特·卡瓦诺被提名为最高法院大法官的信息。

sentences.en: That individual strongly requested confidentiality, declined to come forward or press the matter further, and I have honored that decision.
sentences.zh: 那个人强烈要求保密，拒绝站出来或进一步追究此事，我尊重了这一决定。

sentences.en: After all of that deliberation that ended with Ford not coming forward,
sentences.zh: 在所有以福特没有站出来而告终的审议之后，

sentences.en: there are now all of these other external forces coming into play again that are basically starting to take her story out of her own hands.
sentences.zh: 现在又有所有这些外部力量再次发挥作用，基本上开始把她的故事从她自己手中夺走。

sentences.en: And in this moment, she realizes, okay, it looks like my best course of action is to actually tell my story to The Washington PoSt.
sentences.zh: 就在这一刻，她意识到，好吧，看起来我最好的行动方案实际上是把我的故事告诉《华盛顿邮报》。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 一个月的时间，让你越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So that afternoon, my phone rings, and it's Debbie Katz, and she's calling me in the middle of this whole thing.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，我的电话响了，是黛比·卡茨，她在整件事中间给我打电话。

sentences.en: And she says to me, my client can't testify.
sentences.zh: 她对我说，我的当事人不能作证。

sentences.en: And why is she saying that to you?
sentences.zh: 她为什么对你这么说？

sentences.en: Because at this point, it's basically taken everything Ford has had to do this Washington Post piece.
sentences.zh: 因为在这一点上，福特做这篇《华盛顿邮报》的文章基本上已经耗尽了她所有的精力。

sentences.en: She's already gone further than she had anticipated going.
sentences.zh: 她已经走得比她预期的要远了。

sentences.en: The idea of flying to Washington and giving testimony, that's not something she's ever really even contemplated.
sentences.zh: 飞往华盛顿并作证的想法，那根本不是她真正考虑过的事情。

sentences.en: Debra Katz is the attorney representing Christine Blasey Ford.
sentences.zh: 黛布拉·卡茨是代表克里斯汀·布莱西·福特的律师。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: So the next morning, Debbie Katz is on a whole bunch of morning TV shows.
sentences.zh: 所以第二天早上，黛比·卡茨出现在一大堆早间电视节目中。

sentences.en: And the hosts ask her the obvious question, which is, will your client testify?
sentences.zh: 主持人们问了她一个显而易见的问题，那就是，你的当事人会作证吗？

sentences.en: Ms. Katz, is your client willing to testify before the Judiciary Committee?
sentences.zh: 卡茨女士，你的当事人愿意在司法委员会面前作证吗？

sentences.en: And Katz says...
sentences.zh: 卡茨说……

sentences.en: The answer is yes.
sentences.zh: 答案是肯定的。

sentences.en: The answer is yes.
sentences.zh: 答案是肯定的。

sentences.en: Didn't she just tell you that she wouldn't testify?
sentences.zh: 她刚才不是告诉你她不会作证吗？

sentences.en: Well, it's true that for Ford, the prospect of going to Washington at that point seemed unthinkable.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实，对于福特来说，当时去华盛顿的前景似乎是不可想象的。

sentences.en: But the lawyers and advisors essentially have two reasons.
sentences.zh: 但律师和顾问们本质上有两个原因。

sentences.en: One, they feel they need to buy her time.
sentences.zh: 第一，她们觉得需要为她争取时间。

sentences.en: They tell her that they need to keep her options open and that she can always back out later.
sentences.zh: 她们告诉她，她们需要保持她的选择余地，而且她以后随时可以退出。

sentences.en: Second, things have changed at this point.
sentences.zh: 第二，此时情况已经发生了变化。

sentences.en: And they now feel that to kind of preserve the integrity of her story, she needs to tell it live.
sentences.zh: 她们现在觉得，为了保持她故事的完整性，她需要现场讲述它。

sentences.en: They've seen already privately that they think she's going to be a very powerful, very credible witness.
sentences.zh: 她们已经在私下里看到，她们认为她会成为一个非常有力量、非常可信的证人。

sentences.en: And they want her to tell that story unfiltered and unmediated to the American public.
sentences.zh: 她们希望她能向美国公众原汁原味、不加修饰地讲述那个故事。

sentences.en: So essentially, they're bluffing to preserve that option.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，她们是在虚张声势以保留那个选择。

sentences.en: So at that point, two different things are happening in public and in private.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一点上，公开和私下里正在发生两件不同的事情。

sentences.en: In public...
sentences.zh: 公开场合……

sentences.en: Ford's lawyers issued their latest salvo, telling the Senate Judiciary Committee that she wishes to testify,
sentences.zh: 福特的律师发出了她们最新的攻势，告诉参议院司法委员会她希望作证，

sentences.en: provided that we can agree on terms that are fair and which ensure her safety.
sentences.zh: 前提是我们能就公平且能确保她安全的条款达成一致。

sentences.en: The lawyers are beginning to negotiate with the Republicans for Ford to appear.
sentences.zh: 律师们开始与共和党人谈判，让福特出面。

sentences.en: And it seems like Ford is in some sense preparing to come to Washington.
sentences.zh: 看起来福特在某种意义上正在准备前往华盛顿。

sentences.en: We're going to hear from them hopefully on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我们希望周一能从她们那里得到消息。

sentences.en: I'm so glad it's a public hearing because I do think the public needs to hear from both sides.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴这是一场公开听证会，因为我确实认为公众需要听听双方的意见。

sentences.en: But in private, she's sending her advisors notes like this.
sentences.zh: 但在私下里，她给她的顾问们发了这样的便条。

sentences.en: I'm feeling way too much pressure at the moment.
sentences.zh: 我此刻感到压力太大了。

sentences.en: And Katz says,
sentences.zh: 卡茨说，

sentences.en: Believe me, I don't want to be another pressure.
sentences.zh: 相信我，我不想成为另一种压力。

sentences.en: I'm just cognizant of the time constraints.
sentences.zh: 我只是意识到时间紧迫。

sentences.en: We need to get an email out to Grassley and Feinstein soon.
sentences.zh: 我们需要尽快给格拉斯利和范斯坦发一封电子邮件。

sentences.en: Ford writes back,
sentences.zh: 福特回信说，

sentences.en: I can't go there.
sentences.zh: 我不能去那里。

sentences.en: She inserts a sad emoji.
sentences.zh: 她插入了一个悲伤的表情符号。

sentences.en: To DC.
sentences.zh: 去华盛顿特区。

sentences.en: And Katz says,
sentences.zh: 卡茨说，

sentences.en: That's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: We can always pull out on the basis that they wouldn't come up with fair rules.
sentences.zh: 我们随时可以以他们无法提出公平规则为由退出。

sentences.en: This is the right next step.
sentences.zh: 这是正确的下一步。

sentences.en: But the attorney really wants to make sure that she has the green light from her client to proceed with the negotiations.
sentences.zh: 但律师确实想确保她得到了当事人的绿灯，以便继续进行谈判。

sentences.en: So she says,
sentences.zh: 所以她说，

sentences.en: To clarify,
sentences.zh: 澄清一下，

sentences.en: You're okay with us sending the email, which we need to do soon.
sentences.zh: 你同意我们发送那封邮件，我们确实需要尽快发送。

sentences.en: But you want us to be clear that if they don't agree to fair terms, you won't go forward.
sentences.zh: 但你希望我们明确一点：如果他们不同意公平条款，你就不会继续推进。

sentences.en: And Ford writes back, I want you to know, as you are writing, that I can't guarantee I'll go to DC.
sentences.zh: 福特回信说：我想让你知道，正如你所写的那样，我不能保证我会去华盛顿特区。

sentences.en: And she inserts an emoji with a bead of sweat.
sentences.zh: 她还插入了一个冒汗的表情符号。

sentences.en: Can I see final version?
sentences.zh: 我能看看最终版本吗？

sentences.en: And then she adds,
sentences.zh: 接着她补充道：

sentences.en: I'm so scared I can't breathe.
sentences.zh: 我害怕得无法呼吸。

sentences.en: We've seen Republicans, congressional Republicans, really lining up behind this idea that she needs to testify on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我们看到共和党人，国会共和党人，真的开始支持她必须在周一作证的观点。

sentences.en: You have Senator Jeff Flake saying that she needs to testify on Monday.
sentences.zh: 杰夫·弗莱克参议员说她必须在周一作证。

sentences.en: You have Senator Collins saying that she needs to testify on Monday.
sentences.zh: 柯林斯参议员也说她必须在周一作证。

sentences.en: But by Friday, September 21st, the Republicans are losing patience.
sentences.zh: 但到了9月21日星期五，共和党人已经失去了耐心。

sentences.en: They announced that they're going to go ahead and hold to vote the following Monday if a deal has not been reached for Ford to come.
sentences.zh: 他们宣布，如果福特还没达成来作证的协议，他们将在下周一直接进行投票。

sentences.en: You've watched the fight.
sentences.zh: 你目睹了这场斗争。

sentences.en: You've watched the tactics.
sentences.zh: 你目睹了这些策略。

sentences.en: But here's what I want to tell you.
sentences.zh: 但我想告诉你的是：

sentences.en: In the very near future, Judge Kavanaugh will be on the United States Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 在不久的将来，卡瓦诺法官将进入美国最高法院。

sentences.en: And so finally, over the weekend, a deal does materialize.
sentences.zh: 最终，在周末，协议确实达成了。

sentences.en: By Sunday, Ford has committed to coming to Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 到了周日，福特承诺会前往华盛顿特区。

sentences.en: And then within hours, the whole landscape changes again.
sentences.zh: 然而几小时内，整个局势再次发生了变化。

sentences.en: So after all of these weeks of wondering whether other accounts are going to surface about Kavanaugh, two do at almost the same time.
sentences.zh: 在经历了数周关于是否会有其他针对卡瓦诺的指控浮出水面的猜测后，几乎在同一时间出现了两起。

sentences.en: We have a second allegation of sexual misconduct against Judge Brett Kavanaugh this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，我们收到了针对布雷特·卡瓦诺法官的第二起性行为不端指控。

sentences.en: The first is the story of Deborah Ramirez, which is published in The New Yorker.
sentences.zh: 第一起是黛博拉·拉米雷斯的事件，发表在《纽约客》杂志上。

sentences.en: One of his Yale classmates tells The New Yorker magazine that Kavanaugh exposed himself to her at a party about 35 years ago.
sentences.zh: 他的一位耶鲁同学告诉《纽约客》，大约35年前在一次聚会上，卡瓦诺曾向她暴露自己。

sentences.en: It's about a drunken incident at a party at Yale many years ago.
sentences.zh: 那是多年前在耶鲁的一次聚会上发生的醉酒事件。

sentences.en: It's about Kavanaugh allegedly thrusting his penis in her face, even to the point where she had to touch it as she was pushing him away.
sentences.zh: 据称卡瓦诺当时把生殖器凑到她脸上，甚至让她在推开他时不得不触碰到它。

sentences.en: At the same time, Michael Avenatti, the lawyer who's become a very familiar public face because he's represented Stormy Daniels,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，迈克尔·阿文纳蒂，那位因为代理斯托米·丹尼尔斯而广为人知的律师，

sentences.en: tweets out what sound like very serious allegations against Kavanaugh.
sentences.zh: 在推特上发布了听起来针对卡瓦诺的严重指控。

sentences.en: Accusing Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh of explosive instances of sexual misconduct.
sentences.zh: 指控最高法院提名人布雷特·卡瓦诺存在爆炸性的性行为不端事件。

sentences.en: He says, We are aware of significant evidence of multiple House parties in the Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 他说：我们掌握了重要证据，显示在20世纪80年代初的华盛顿特区，

sentences.en: area during the early 1980s, during which Brett Kavanaugh would participate in the targeting of women with alcohol drugs to allow a, quote,
sentences.zh: 布雷特·卡瓦诺曾参与针对女性的行动，利用酒精和药物，让一群男人随后对她们进行，引用，

sentences.en: train of men to subsequently gang rape them.
sentences.zh: 轮奸。

sentences.en: Later on, it's going to become clear that these two allegations are very different.
sentences.zh: 后来人们会清楚，这两起指控性质截然不同。

sentences.en: But in that moment, they sort of seemed like a pair because they came into public view at the same time.
sentences.zh: 但在当时，由于它们同时进入公众视野，看起来就像是一对。

sentences.en: So what people had assumed would happen, that additional allegations of sexual misconduct against Kavanaugh
sentences.zh: 所以人们原本预期的，即针对卡瓦诺的额外性行为不端指控

sentences.en: would strengthen Ford's accusation and be evidence of a pattern, did not happen.
sentences.zh: 会加强福特的指控并证明这是一种模式，这种情况并没有发生。

sentences.en: In fact, it was by many measures the opposite.
sentences.zh: 事实上，从许多方面来看，结果恰恰相反。

sentences.en: This new allegation is ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 这个新指控简直荒谬。

sentences.en: I mean, to accuse somebody of premeditated gang rape, which is what this Michael Avenatti client has done, it just doesn't add up.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，指控某人预谋轮奸，也就是迈克尔·阿文纳蒂的客户所做的那样，这根本说不通。

sentences.en: It does not...
sentences.zh: 这根本不……

sentences.en: Where Ford's accusation against Kavanaugh had pushed on some of those, like, unanswered, confusing questions swirling around Me Too,
sentences.zh: 如果说福特对卡瓦诺的指控触及了“我也是”运动中那些悬而未决、令人困惑的问题，

sentences.en: these new allegations pushed on those questions even harder.
sentences.zh: 那么这些新指控则更猛烈地冲击了这些问题。

sentences.en: And so Republicans and other critics immediately pounce.
sentences.zh: 于是共和党人和其他批评者立即抓住了机会。

sentences.en: Thirty-six years ago, nobody ever knew about it, nobody ever heard about it.
sentences.zh: 三十六年前的事，没人知道，也没人听说过。

sentences.en: And now a new charge comes up, and she said, well, it might not be him, and there were gaps, and she said she was totally inebriated.
sentences.zh: 现在又冒出一个新指控，她说，嗯，可能不是他，而且记忆有断层，她还说她当时完全喝醉了。

sentences.en: Now they're coming out, and they're lumping all of these allegations together and saying it's all part of a political hit job by the Democrats to take Kavanaugh down.
sentences.zh: 现在他们站出来，把所有这些指控混为一谈，说这全是民主党为了搞垮卡瓦诺而策划的政治攻击。

sentences.en: Take him down.
sentences.zh: 搞垮他。

sentences.en: Take him down at whatever coSt.
sentences.zh: 不惜一切代价搞垮他。

sentences.en: It is pure and simple.
sentences.zh: 这纯粹就是。

sentences.en: Raw politics at whatever coSt.
sentences.zh: 不惜一切代价的赤裸裸的政治斗争。

sentences.en: So it's Thursday, September 27th.
sentences.zh: 现在是9月27日星期四。

sentences.en: It's the day of the testimony.
sentences.zh: 这是作证的日子。

sentences.en: This morning, we continue our hearing on the nomination of Judge Brent Kavanaugh to serve as associate justice on our Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 今天上午，我们继续就布雷特·卡瓦诺法官担任最高法院大法官的提名举行听证会。

sentences.en: Christine Blasey Ford has, in fact, shown up.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀·布莱西·福特确实出席了。

sentences.en: Thanks, of course, to Dr. Ford and Judge Kavanaugh for accepting our committee's invitation to testify.
sentences.zh: 当然，感谢福特博士和卡瓦诺法官接受我们委员会的作证邀请。

sentences.en: And there's this mood across the country that something really important is going to be decided that day.
sentences.zh: 全国上下都弥漫着一种气氛，觉得那天将决定一件非常重要的事情。

sentences.en: And I think that was even truer inside the room.
sentences.zh: 我认为在那个房间里这种感觉更强烈。

sentences.en: It felt like a tribunal.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像一个法庭。

sentences.en: It was a much smaller space than the way it looked on TV, and the lights were so incredibly bright, like everybody was under a lot of scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 那个空间比电视上看起来小得多，灯光亮得惊人，仿佛每个人都在严密的审视之下。

sentences.en: And the two sides were just bumping up against each other.
sentences.zh: 双方就在那里针锋相对。

sentences.en: Tarana Burke was there, the founder of the Me Too movement.
sentences.zh: “我也是”运动的创始人塔拉纳·伯克也在场。

sentences.en: Just a few feet away stood Ashley Kavanaugh, the judge's wife, and she had this look of horror on her face.
sentences.zh: 离她几英尺远站着法官的妻子阿什利·卡瓦诺，她脸上带着惊恐的表情。

sentences.en: And even the way the testimony unfolded added to the impression that one side was going to win and one side was going to lose.
sentences.zh: 甚至作证过程本身也加深了这种印象：一方会赢，另一方会输。

sentences.en: I am here today not because I want to be.
sentences.zh: 我今天站在这里，并非出于自愿。

sentences.en: I am terrified.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常恐惧。

sentences.en: I am here because I believe it is my civic duty to tell you what happened to me while Brett Kavanaugh and I were in high school.
sentences.zh: 我站在这里是因为我相信，我有公民义务告诉你们，我和布雷特·卡瓦诺上高中时发生了什么。

sentences.en: Christine Blasey Ford was very polite, but she was also very firm.
sentences.zh: 克里斯汀·布莱西·福特非常有礼貌，但也非常坚定。

sentences.en: She was very precise, and many people found her enormously credible.
sentences.zh: 她非常精确，许多人认为她极其可信。

sentences.en: Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 主席先生。

sentences.en: But immediately afterwards, during Judge Kavanaugh's turn,
sentences.zh: 但在那之后，轮到卡瓦诺法官时，

sentences.en: Ranking Member Feinstein, members of the committee.
sentences.zh: 范斯坦资深委员，各位委员会成员。

sentences.en: He comes out swinging.
sentences.zh: 他开始反击了。

sentences.en: This confirmation process has become a national disgrace.
sentences.zh: 这次确认程序已经成了国家的耻辱。

sentences.en: And he's vehemently denying any wrongdoing, not just Ford's allegation.
sentences.zh: 他极力否认任何不当行为，不仅仅是福特的指控。

sentences.en: Gangs, illegitimate children, fights on boats in Rhode Island.
sentences.zh: 什么帮派、私生子、罗德岛船上的斗殴。

sentences.en: And all nonsense.
sentences.zh: 全是胡说八道。

sentences.en: And he's positioning himself as a kind of voice of male grievance about the Me Too movement.
sentences.zh: 他把自己定位为男性对“我也是”运动不满的代言人。

sentences.en: This whole two-week effort has been a calculated and orchestrated political hit.
sentences.zh: 这整整两周的努力是一场精心策划的政治打击。

sentences.en: So I wake up the next morning and I talk to Debbie Katz, one of Christine Blasey Ford's lawyers.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上我醒来，和克里斯汀·布莱西·福特的律师之一黛比·卡茨谈了话。

sentences.en: And she tells me to take a cab to the Watergate Hotel in Washington.
sentences.zh: 她让我打车去华盛顿的水门酒店。

sentences.en: And we meet at the hotel, and she takes me into this little, narrow conference room.
sentences.zh: 我们在酒店见面，她把我带进了一个狭窄的小会议室。

sentences.en: And a minute later, in walks Christine Blasey Ford.
sentences.zh: 一分钟后，克里斯汀·布莱西·福特走了进来。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, I'm face-to-face with this woman we've all watched so closely.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，我面对面见到了我们一直密切关注的这位女性。

sentences.en: And what was your impression?
sentences.zh: 你当时的印象是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, honestly, my strongest impression of meeting her the next morning is that this is just one person.
sentences.zh: 说实话，第二天早上见到她，我最强烈的印象是，她只是一个普通人。

sentences.en: She looked so everyday.
sentences.zh: 她看起来很平常。

sentences.en: Her hair was tousled from sleep.
sentences.zh: 她的头发因为睡觉而显得凌乱。

sentences.en: She was wearing flip-flops.
sentences.zh: 她穿着人字拖。

sentences.en: The kind of dark suit she had worn the day before was gone.
sentences.zh: 她前一天穿的那种深色套装已经不见了。

sentences.en: She was very focused on sort of the practical questions of, okay, how do I get home to California?
sentences.zh: 她非常专注于一些实际问题，比如：好吧，我怎么回加州？

sentences.en: Her flight was about to leave.
sentences.zh: 她的航班快要起飞了。

sentences.en: She was trying to figure out, okay, how do I resume my normal existence?
sentences.zh: 她试图弄清楚：好吧，我该如何恢复正常生活？

sentences.en: So after Ford leaves, I continue to spend the morning with Debbie Katz and her law partner, Lisa Banks.
sentences.zh: 福特离开后，我继续和黛比·卡茨以及她的合伙人丽莎·班克斯共度了上午。

sentences.en: And basically, they're waiting, like the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 基本上，她们和我们其他人一样在等待。

sentences.en: They're waiting to see what the Senate Judiciary Committee is going to do.
sentences.zh: 她们在等待参议院司法委员会会有什么动作。

sentences.en: So we go back to their office, and we're in a big conference room, and the TV is on.
sentences.zh: 我们回到她们的办公室，坐在一个大会议室里，电视开着。

sentences.en: And they're waiting for some sort of news development.
sentences.zh: 她们在等待任何新闻进展。

sentences.en: Well, she got the opportunity to testify and have her life turned upside down.
sentences.zh: 她得到了作证的机会，生活却被彻底颠覆了。

sentences.en: And for what?
sentences.zh: 为了什么？

sentences.en: So that he could be placed on the court just like he would have been.
sentences.zh: 为了让他能像原本计划的那样进入最高法院。

sentences.en: Even though they're at the center of this thing, they're like the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 尽管她们处于事件的中心，但她们和我们其他人一样。

sentences.en: They don't know what's going to happen next.
sentences.zh: 她们不知道接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: If there's a 16-year-old girl in a few months who undergoes something similar, will she be encouraged to tell somebody because of Christine?
sentences.zh: 如果几个月后有一个16岁的女孩经历了类似的事情，她会因为克里斯汀而受到鼓励去告诉别人吗？

sentences.en: She probably will be encouraged, but my question remains the same.
sentences.zh: 她可能会受到鼓励，但我的问题依然存在。

sentences.en: To what effect?
sentences.zh: 有什么效果？

sentences.en: To what end?
sentences.zh: 最终目的是什么？

sentences.en: Is it going to change anything?
sentences.zh: 这会改变什么吗？

sentences.en: So these two women have worked together on these kinds of issues for years.
sentences.zh: 这两位女性多年来一直致力于这类问题。

sentences.en: But as we're sitting there in the conference room, they sort of adopt different positions.
sentences.zh: 但当我们坐在会议室里时，她们采取了不同的立场。

sentences.en: Debbie Katz plays the optimiSt.
sentences.zh: 黛比·卡茨扮演乐观主义者。

sentences.en: If we're evaluating where we are today versus where we are in a year ago, there's no question that a year ago she would not have been allowed to testify.
sentences.zh: 如果我们评估今天和一年前相比，毫无疑问，一年前她根本不可能获准作证。

sentences.en: And we're not going to move it.
sentences.zh: 我们不会让它过去。

sentences.en: Giving her that support and insisting she be heard.
sentences.zh: 给予她支持并坚持让她被倾听。

sentences.en: I'm not saying the movement's a failure.
sentences.zh: 我不是说这场运动失败了。

sentences.en: I'm really not.
sentences.zh: 真的不是。

sentences.en: And Lisa Banks, her partner, kind of plays the pessimiSt.
sentences.zh: 而她的合伙人丽莎·班克斯则扮演悲观主义者。

sentences.en: And she says,
sentences.zh: 她说：

sentences.en: Despite the power of the movement and how everybody in this country has woken up and recognized how women have been treated forever, right?
sentences.zh: 尽管这场运动很有力量，尽管这个国家的每个人都觉醒了，认识到女性一直以来是如何被对待的，对吧？

sentences.en: Now we're awake to it.
sentences.zh: 现在我们意识到了。

sentences.en: We're energized.
sentences.zh: 我们充满了活力。

sentences.en: We're mobilized.
sentences.zh: 我们动员起来了。

sentences.en: And yet because we have these institutions, the results seem to be the same.
sentences.zh: 然而，因为我们有这些体制，结果似乎还是一样。

sentences.en: Maybe the message is different.
sentences.zh: 也许信息不同了。

sentences.en: Maybe the messaging is different and they cover their ass in a different way.
sentences.zh: 也许传达方式不同了，他们用不同的方式来掩盖自己的过失。

sentences.en: My problem is, is the result is exactly the same.
sentences.zh: 我的问题是，结果完全一样。

sentences.en: And even after the backlash after Trump's election, and even after Harvey Weinstein and the Me Too movement.
sentences.zh: 即使在特朗普当选后的反弹之后，即使在哈维·韦恩斯坦和“我也是”运动之后。

sentences.en: The Senate hasn't changed.
sentences.zh: 参议院没有改变。

sentences.en: The White House hasn't changed.
sentences.zh: 白宫没有改变。

sentences.en: And we have a Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 我们还有最高法院。

sentences.en: And that's what matters.
sentences.zh: 那才是最重要的。

sentences.en: And all of those entities seek to maintain the status quo in terms of white male power and privilege.
sentences.zh: 所有这些实体都在寻求维持白人男性权力和特权的现状。

sentences.en: I will vote to confirm Judge Kavanaugh.
sentences.zh: 我将投票确认卡瓦诺法官的提名。

sentences.en: And by the next week, we have a much stronger sense of where this is headed.
sentences.zh: 到了下周，我们对事态的发展有了更清晰的认识。

sentences.en: We need to form a protest and go to the polls and protest and vote some of these people out and vote for Republicans.
sentences.zh: 我们需要组织抗议，去投票站抗议，把这些人选下去，投票给共和党人。

sentences.en: The display of rage that Kavanaugh had shown during his testimony had really given many Americans permission to voice their own discomfort and anger
sentences.zh: 卡瓦诺在作证时表现出的愤怒，确实让许多美国人有理由表达他们自己的不适和愤怒，

sentences.en: at where the Me Too movement had gone.
sentences.zh: 针对“我也是”运动的发展方向。

sentences.en: Today is Kavanaugh.
sentences.zh: 今天是卡瓦诺。

sentences.en: Tomorrow it could be your brother, your husband, your father, or your son.
sentences.zh: 明天可能是你的兄弟、丈夫、父亲或儿子。

sentences.en: I don't like what I just saw here.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢我刚才在这里看到的。

sentences.en: Anybody can be accused of something.
sentences.zh: 任何人都可以被指控。

sentences.en: And even if they're trying to defend themselves, you still want to make it wrong.
sentences.zh: 即使他们试图为自己辩护，你仍然想让他们显得有罪。

sentences.en: And that's not right.
sentences.zh: 那是不对的。

sentences.en: You know, Mike Davis, who was the head Republican staffer on the Senate Judiciary Committee,
sentences.zh: 你知道，参议院司法委员会的首席共和党幕僚迈克·戴维斯，

sentences.en: later told me in interviews that, you know, Avenatti weighing in with the allegations of gang rape had been a gift, had been a gift.
sentences.zh: 后来在采访中告诉我，阿文纳蒂抛出轮奸指控简直是天赐良机。

sentences.en: That this had provided, you know, Kavanaugh's defenders and people more broadly with the claims that this whole thing had gone too far
sentences.zh: 这为卡瓦诺的辩护者以及更广泛的人群提供了借口，声称这一切已经走得太远了，

sentences.en: and that men were being unfairly accused and targeted and victimized.
sentences.zh: 男性正在被不公平地指控、针对和迫害。

sentences.en: And so this is really the mood that's taken hold on October 6th, the day of the final vote on Kavanaugh's nomination, when I'm in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 这就是10月6日，即卡瓦诺提名最终投票日当天所形成的气氛，当时我正在华盛顿特区，

sentences.en: with Lisa Banks and Debbie Katz at their office.
sentences.zh: 和丽莎·班克斯以及黛比·卡茨在她们的办公室里。

sentences.en: And then we got in the car and drove to Capitol Hill to watch the confirmation vote.
sentences.zh: 然后我们上了车，开车前往国会山观看确认投票。

sentences.en: And you have this, I don't know any trial lawyer who doesn't have this, if I try a three-week case, it takes me three weeks to the day
sentences.zh: 你有这种感觉，我不认识哪个出庭律师没有这种感觉：如果我处理一个为期三周的案件，我需要整整三周的时间，

sentences.en: to go through every single moment of what we could have done differently.
sentences.zh: 去回顾我们本可以做得不同的每一个瞬间。

sentences.en: And it's clear that they're trying to find ways to make sense of this.
sentences.zh: 显然，他们正试图找到理解这一切的方法。

sentences.en: Whatever is happening in there today has been affected by what she's done.
sentences.zh: 无论今天那里发生了什么，都受到了她所作所为的影响。

sentences.en: And we need to, even if the vote goes the wrong way, which it will, right?
sentences.zh: 我们需要这样做，即使投票结果不尽如人意，而事实也确实如此，对吧？

sentences.en: But it's, it's, the process has been affected and impacted.
sentences.zh: 但整个过程确实受到了影响和冲击。

sentences.en: And she did that.
sentences.zh: 而她做到了这一点。

sentences.en: As a reminder to our guests in the galleries,
sentences.zh: 提醒一下在画廊里的各位来宾，

sentences.en: expressions of approval or disapproval are not permitted in the Senate galleries.
sentences.zh: 参议院画廊内不允许表达赞成或反对的意见。

sentences.en: So we walk into the Senate gallery.
sentences.zh: 于是我们走进参议院画廊。

sentences.en: You know, there are sort of big wooden doors.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那里有几扇巨大的木门。

sentences.en: You walk down these white marble stairs.
sentences.zh: 你走下这些白色大理石台阶。

sentences.en: And soon we're all seated in this almost majestic Senate gallery.
sentences.zh: 很快，我们就都坐在了这几乎庄严的参议院画廊里。

sentences.en: And Don McGahn, Trump's White House counsel, is sitting across from me watching the proceedings with a smile on his face.
sentences.zh: 特朗普的白宫法律顾问唐·麦克甘坐在我对面，面带微笑地注视着整个过程。

sentences.en: A good man, a good man with sterling academic credentials.
sentences.zh: 一个好人，一个拥有卓越学术背景的好人。

sentences.en: And, you know, one by one, the Republicans are getting up and...
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，共和党人一个接一个地站起来……

sentences.en: But imagine what this has been like for Judge Kavanaugh's parents.
sentences.zh: 但试想一下，这对卡瓦诺法官的父母来说是什么样的感受。

sentences.en: Talking about...
sentences.zh: 谈论着……

sentences.en: For his wife.
sentences.zh: 对他的妻子来说。

sentences.en: ...how Kavanaugh is such a victim.
sentences.zh: ……卡瓦诺是多么无辜的受害者。

sentences.en: For his children.
sentences.zh: 对他的孩子们来说。

sentences.en: You know, Democrats are doing the exact opposite.
sentences.zh: 你知道，民主党人正在做完全相反的事情。

sentences.en: The fact that this touched a nerve to so many Americans, and particularly to women who have gone through this experience, should put this whole debate in context.
sentences.zh: 这件事触动了如此多美国人的神经，尤其是那些经历过类似遭遇的女性，这一事实应该让我们把整个辩论放在背景中去审视。

sentences.en: We ought to understand the gravity of this debate in light of the cultural change we are now facing in America.
sentences.zh: 鉴于我们现在在美国面临的文化变革，我们应该理解这场辩论的重要性。

sentences.en: And then in the end, the vote is taken and...
sentences.zh: 最后，投票开始了，然后……

sentences.en: On this vote, the ayes are 50.
sentences.zh: 本次投票，赞成票为50票。

sentences.en: The nays are 48.
sentences.zh: 反对票为48票。

sentences.en: It lines up almost to a T.
sentences.zh: 结果几乎完全一致。

sentences.en: You know, Republicans in favor, Democrats against, and...
sentences.zh: 你知道，共和党人赞成，民主党人反对，然后……

sentences.en: The nomination of Brett M.
sentences.zh: 布雷特·M·卡瓦诺（Brett M. Kavanaugh）

sentences.en: Kavanaugh of Maryland to be an associate justice of the
sentences.zh: 被提名为美国最高法院大法官，

sentences.en: Supreme Court of the United States is confirmed.
sentences.zh: 现已确认通过。

sentences.en: Kavanaugh is confirmed.
sentences.zh: 卡瓦诺确认当选。

sentences.en: So, Jody and Megan, it's been a year since this day.
sentences.zh: 那么，朱迪和梅根，距离那一天已经过去一年了。

sentences.en: We started this conversation by talking about where the country was in this moment.
sentences.zh: 我们开始这段对话时，谈到了当时国家所处的境地。

sentences.en: When Christine Blasey Ford learned that the man she said had sexually assaulted her in high school was being considered for the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 当克里斯汀·布莱西·福特得知那个她声称在高中时性侵过她的男人正被考虑任命为最高法院大法官时。

sentences.en: You said that there were so many unanswered questions about the Me Too movement when she learned that.
sentences.zh: 你说过，当她得知这个消息时，关于“我也是”（Me Too）运动还有许多未解的问题。

sentences.en: In Kavanaugh's confirmation, and in the months since, have we answered any of those questions?
sentences.zh: 在卡瓦诺的确认过程中，以及随后的几个月里，我们回答了其中任何一个问题吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: It's like we took all of these hard questions that were so heated to begin with, and we just poured a political gasoline on them, which is not a recipe for resolving anything.
sentences.zh: 就像我们把所有这些本来就激烈且棘手的问题，又浇上了政治汽油，这根本不是解决问题的办法。

sentences.en: Look, I do think that there was some serious reassessment, especially on a private level, of long-ago behavior.
sentences.zh: 听着，我确实认为进行了一些严肃的重新评估，特别是在个人层面，对过去行为的审视。

sentences.en: But did we move forward on solving any of these fundamental questions about Me Too?
sentences.zh: 但我们在解决关于“我也是”运动的任何基本问题上取得进展了吗？

sentences.en: I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 我不这么认为。

sentences.en: It's like instead of causing progress, the whole thing caused us to pull apart even farther.
sentences.zh: 这就像整件事非但没有促进进步，反而导致我们分歧更深了。

sentences.en: Why do you think that that is?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是为什么？

sentences.en: It feels like when we look at the stories that have played out in the realms of entertainment
sentences.zh: 感觉当我们审视那些在娱乐界

sentences.en: and corporate life, it feels like on those we're capable of having a more nuanced, forward-looking discussion.
sentences.zh: 和企业界上演的故事时，我们似乎更有能力进行更细致、更具前瞻性的讨论。

sentences.en: In politics, these stories just become imbued with the heat and poison of American political life, and so it's just very hard to come to any kind of resolution about them.
sentences.zh: 而在政治领域，这些故事被注入了美国政治生活的热度和毒素，因此很难就它们达成任何形式的共识。

sentences.en: And these two individuals, Brett Kavanaugh and Christine Blasey Ford, were turned into symbols by both sides, and yet they're still symbols.
sentences.zh: 而布雷特·卡瓦诺和克里斯汀·布莱西·福特这两个人，被双方变成了符号，而且他们至今仍是符号。

sentences.en: Brett Kavanaugh is now on the Supreme Court.
sentences.zh: 布雷特·卡瓦诺现在已经在最高法院了。

sentences.en: He was always going to be this visible, conservative vote on the court, but now he's going to be trailed by this cultural identity, a representation of male grievance.
sentences.zh: 他注定会成为法院里那个显眼的保守派投票者，但现在他将背负着这种文化身份，成为男性不满情绪的代表。

sentences.en: And Christine Blasey Ford, who went back to California with hopes of being able to return to a normal life, is far from it.
sentences.zh: 而怀着重回正常生活希望回到加州的克里斯汀·布莱西·福特，离正常生活还很远。

sentences.en: It's not certain if and when that will ever happen.
sentences.zh: 不确定这种情况是否以及何时会发生。

sentences.en: I mean, she is now seen as an icon by many women.
sentences.zh: 我是说，她现在被许多女性视为偶像。

sentences.en: She has been flooded with tens of thousands of letters from victims of sexual assault and sexual harassment and abuse who have poured their hearts out to her.
sentences.zh: 她收到了成千上万封来自性侵、性骚扰和虐待受害者的信件，她们向她倾诉了心声。

sentences.en: But she's also receiving death threats and is often scared to go out in public.
sentences.zh: 但她也收到了死亡威胁，常常不敢公开露面。

sentences.en: And so she is the symbol that she never wanted to be.
sentences.zh: 所以，她成了她从未想过要成为的那个符号。

sentences.en: And so is he.
sentences.zh: 他也是如此。

sentences.en: Megan and Jody, thank you again.
sentences.zh: 梅根和朱迪，再次感谢你们。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for having us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我们。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Likewise, China should start an investigation into the virus.
sentences.zh: 同样，中国也应该对病毒展开调查。

sentences.en: Because what happened to China is just about as bad as what happened with Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 因为发生在中国的事情和发生在乌克兰的事情几乎一样糟糕。

sentences.en: On Thursday, President Trump called on China to investigate former Vice President Joe Biden and his family over work that Biden's son did there.
sentences.zh: 周四，特朗普总统呼吁中国调查前副总统乔·拜登及其家人，涉及拜登的儿子在那里所做的工作。

sentences.en: The remarks echoed Trump's request to the president of Ukraine, already the subject of an impeachment inquiry, and could strengthen the Democrats' case against the president.
sentences.zh: 这些言论呼应了特朗普对乌克兰总统的要求，而这已经是弹劾调查的主题，可能会加强民主党人针对总统的指控。

sentences.en: The president of the United States encouraging a foreign nation to interfere again to help his campaign by investigating a radical is a fundamental breach of the president's
sentences.zh: 美国总统鼓励外国势力再次干预以帮助其竞选，通过调查政敌，这是对总统职位的根本性背叛。

sentences.en: office.
sentences.zh: 办公室。

sentences.en: Speaking to reporters, House Intelligence Committee Chairman Adam Schiff, one of the leaders of the impeachment inquiry, expressed outrage.
sentences.zh: 众议院情报委员会主席亚当·希夫在向记者发表讲话时表达了愤怒，他是弹劾调查的领导者之一。

sentences.en: It endangers our elections.
sentences.zh: 这危及了我们的选举。

sentences.en: It endangers our national security.
sentences.zh: 这危及了我们的国家安全。

sentences.en: It ought to be condemned by every member of this body, Democrats and Republicans.
sentences.zh: 这应该受到本机构每一位成员的谴责，无论是民主党人还是共和党人。

sentences.en: There is no evidence that Biden's son did anything improper in China.
sentences.zh: 没有证据表明拜登的儿子在中国做了任何不当行为。
